name: Camping 101: Herbalism

angles.text: Gathering plants in the wilderness provides the aromatic herbs needed for camp incense. That makes the work useful for survival as well as alchemy.
Incense Candles lit at camp lift the spirits and replenish the mental reserves of holy healers between skirmishes.
Spellcasters who spend their focus in battle value camp incense, whose soothing scent helps restore their minds and support arcane recovery.

faq.answer: Camping 101: Herbalism connects skilled herb gatherers with instructors who teach them to make Incense Candles for wilderness camps.
An Incense Candle is made from gathered plants and burned at a campsite. Its soothing, revitalizing scent lifts resting companions’ spirits and gives healers and spellcasters a beneficial boost.
faq.q: What is an Incense Candle used for?

faq.answer: Your instructor depends on where you begin: Reyna Stonebranch in Ironforge, Malorne Bladeleaf in Dolanaar, Herbalist Pomeroy in Elwynn Forest, Jandi in Orgrimmar, Faruza in Brill, Komin Winterhoof in Thunder Bluff, or Syriel Nightrain in Valanaar.
faq.q: Who teaches how to make an Incense Candle?

faq.answer: Casting spells and tending wounds drain physical energy and mental focus. The soothing smoke of an Incense Candle helps replenish both, keeping spirits high and casters ready for battle.
faq.q: Why are Incense Candles especially useful for magic users?

aliases: do i need herbalism for camping 101 herbalism
faq.answer: This instruction is for those skilled in gathering plants and herbs. It teaches how to find and use aromatic wild plants.
faq.q: Do you need to be an herbalist to take this quest?

faq.answer: Gathered plants have uses around camp beyond brewing concoctions and salves. They can be made into incense that refreshes weary companions.
faq.q: How does Herbalism tie into camping?

sections.body: Travelers can put roots and petals to use beyond selling fresh stems or brewing draughts. Gatherers meet instructors who teach them to make Incense Candles from wild aromatic plants. These candles support companions on the trail.
sections.title: Wild Flora on the Trail

sections.body: Long journeys through hostile country wear down healers and spellcasters. At an active campsite, an Incense Candle gives off a soothing, revitalizing scent that lifts their spirits and helps them recover clarity and strength before danger calls again. Those who wield magic or tend the wounded value that comfort most.
sections.title: Soothing the Mind

summary: At camps along the trail, Camping 101: Herbalism points gatherers toward instructors who teach them to make Incense Candles. Herbalists use gathered plants to bring comfort to spellcasters and healers on long journeys.
